theme_and_archetype.description: A serious metrology/laboratory ERP-style tool. Focuses on precision, strict data hierarchy, and absolute clarity. Mimics the rigorous nature of NABL accreditation and physical calibration certificates without feeling archaic like Excel.

rules.headings: Tracking-tight, font-semibold to font-bold. Never centered by default.
rules.body: Highly readable, moderate line-height (leading-snug for data, leading-relaxed for reading).
rules.data: ALL numerical inputs, tables, formulas, and calculated deviations MUST use 'font-mono' and 'tabular-nums' to ensure decimal points align perfectly like they would in Excel.

color_palette.rules: No gradients. Use solid, high-contrast colors to ensure legibility of dense data. Teal is forbidden. Tint greys slightly blue (slate) to feel clinical and sterile.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid Surfaces only. NO GLASSMORPHISM. Medical/Clinical/Lab apps require flat solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of critical data.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadow (shadow-sm) on primary containers. Flat design is preferred for data tables to maximize space.
visual_enhancers.radius: Max 6px (rounded-md) to maintain a rigid, highly structural and professional feel.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Customize padding to be dense (h-8 or h-9 max) so multiple readings can be entered efficiently on one screen.
components.tables: Heavy use of Shadcn Table. Must include sticky headers, distinct alternating row colors (bg-slate-50/50), and strict right-alignment for numerical columns.
components.cards: Cardless or flat bounded boxes. Use Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) for the Uncertainty Budget and Excel-vs-App comparison matrices.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded corners. Clear hover states. Use distinct visual weight for 'Approve/Certify' vs 'Calculate'.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize all pixels. Widgets for expiring masters, pending jobs.
grids_and_layouts.calibration_wizard: Split layout. Left sidebar for navigation/progress (Customer -> Product -> Readings -> Review). Main content area for dense data entry. UUT vs Master readings should be displayed in a side-by-side or deeply nested grid to mirror Excel spatial relationships.
grids_and_layouts.certificate_preview: A4 proportioned container (aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.414). Pure white background, thin black borders, strictly printed document styling.

motion.philosophy: Minimalist and instantaneous. In a high-speed data entry environment, delayed animations cause friction.
motion.rules: Hover states must be immediate (150ms). No entrance animations for table rows to prevent lag when loading hundreds of calibration points. Provide clear visual feedback (Toast) upon saving readings or generating certificates.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance, especially for Warning (Amber) and Error (Red) text against white backgrounds.
accessibility.keyboard: Form fields in the Calibration Readings section MUST support rapid Tab-key navigation without focus loss.
accessibility.focus_states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-1 is mandatory for all inputs.

media_and_icons.icon_library: lucide-react (clean, legible at small sizes) or @phosphor-icons/react (dense/technical). Use icons sparingly to label metrics (e.g., Thermometer, Activity, FileText, CheckCircle).

auth_background.description: Industrial robotic/precision machinery. Use as a dark, blurred or overlayed background on the login screen to establish a high-tech tone.

lab_equipment.description: Scientific lab equipment. Can be used in empty states or marketing/onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data density and precision over spacious, airy designs. This replaces an Excel sheet.
The 'Enter Readings' screen is the core product. Use a spreadsheet-like grid for the 5 repeat readings (Master vs UUT). Use tabular numerals (tabular-nums).
Align all numerical data to the right in tables and calculation views. Align text to the left.
Implement the 'Certificate Preview' strictly as a white A4-style page wrapper so users trust the PDF output.
Use badges (Emerald/Amber/Red) aggressively in the Master/Reference Instrument database to highlight validity status.
Install and use 'sonner' for all toast notifications.
Ensure the Excel-vs-App calculation comparison report uses a side-by-side technical layout.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces flat (no glassmorphism for this specific app).
Always use modern button styles (sharp/slightly rounded) with explicit interaction animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute for robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='submit-readings-button').
Use Shadcn calendar for date pickers (NOT HTML <input type='date'>).
